The '''Model 213 Perforator barrel''' was a model of [[Augmented spin barrel/Legends|augmented spin barrel]] that increased the damage output and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] penetration of any weapon it was attached to, but also increased maintenance requirements and downtime due to increased wear and tear on the barrel and frame. The barrel was produced by the company [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] and sold for 1750 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] during [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The attachment was only compatible with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and [[Heavy blaster rifle/Legends|heavy blaster rifles]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Model 213 was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].
